name: c09-rental-car-kayak
intent: On kayak.com, find the cheapest economy or compact rental car at Atlanta airport (ATL), pick-up {date+30} at 10:00 AM, drop-off {date+33} at 10:00 AM. Tell me the company, the car and the total price.
hard_part: Car search form with times; total vs daily price

key_nodes.description: ATL car results for the dates

live_stops_before: any sign-in, account creation, add-to-cart, reservation, booking, payment, consent, CAPTCHA or bot check, and every final/commit/protected button
